portal.noPostsMatchingFilter: No posts match the selected filter.

dashboard.changeDefaultLanguageDesc: Changing the primary language updates which translation serves as the default content for changelog entries, FAQ questions, and roadmap items.
dashboard.changeDefaultLanguageNotice: Existing translations in the new primary language will be promoted to the primary content, and your previous primary content will be preserved as a translation.
dashboard.atLeastOneLanguage: At least one language must remain enabled.
dashboard.swapPreviewError: Could not load the impact preview. Retry before confirming.

ui.loadMoreFailed: Couldn't load more updates. Try again.
ui.languagesDescription: Manage languages available on this product's public portal and content entries.
ui.defaultLanguageHint: This language is used as fallback when translations are missing or no language is detected.
ui.enabledLanguagesHint: Select which languages are available in the public portal switcher and entry editors.
ui.defaultMustBeEnabled: Default language must be one of the enabled languages.
ui.noPostsMatchDesc: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see every open post.
ui.shareAnIdeaDesc: Share an idea and others can vote on it.
ui.newPostDesc: Describe the problem or idea. Others can vote on it and join the conversation.
ui.editPostDesc: Update the title, category, or details for this post.
ui.titlePlaceholder: A short summary, like "Export to CSV"
ui.detailsPlaceholder: What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way?
ui.voteRateLimited: You're doing that too often. Wait a minute and try again.
ui.voteFailed: Couldn't save your vote. Try again.
ui.noCommentsYet: No comments yet. Start the conversation.
ui.signInToJoin: Sign in to join the conversation.
ui.deleteCommentConfirmDesc: It'll be removed from the conversation. This can't be undone.
ui.noActivityDesc: Posts you create, upvote, or comment on will appear here with status changes and new comments highlighted.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Plan what to build next. Drag items between columns to update their status.
roadmap.publicColumnsDesc: Choose which columns appear on your public portal roadmap.
roadmap.newItemModalDesc: Add an initiative or planned feature to your roadmap.
roadmap.editItemModalDesc: Update roadmap item details, assignees, and public visibility.
roadmap.makePublicHelp: When enabled, visitors can see this item on the public roadmap.
roadmap.deleteDialogDesc: This action cannot be undone. Linked feedback posts will not be deleted.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.studioDesc: Announce new features, product updates, and bug fixes to your users.
changelog.emptyStudioDesc: Publish release notes and updates to keep your users informed.
changelog.deleteEntryDesc: This entry will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
changelog.summaryExcerptHelp: Optional short summary for RSS and email notifications
changelog.manageTagsDesc: Create and color-code tags to organize your release notes.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Organize answers to common user questions in categories.
faq.reorderHelp: Drag categories or questions to reorder how they appear on your portal.
faq.emptyCategoriesDesc: Create your first category to start adding questions and answers.
faq.deleteCategoryDesc: Deleting this category will also remove all questions within it.
faq.deleteQuestionDesc: This question will be removed from your FAQ portal.
faq.questionDialogDesc: Provide clear answers to help customers self-serve.
faq.questionPlaceholder: e.g. How do I reset my password?
faq.categoryDialogDesc: Group related questions together (e.g. Billing, Account, Getting Started).
faq.questionLengthError: Question must be between 5 and 200 characters.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Manage programmatic secret keys used to authenticate with the UserHQ API.
apiKeys.emptyDesc: Create a secret API key to automate workflows, sync data, or export feedback.
apiKeys.revokeDialogDesc: Any service using this key will immediately lose access. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.dialogDesc: Generate a token to access the UserHQ REST API.
apiKeys.createdDesc: Copy this key now. For security, it will not be shown again.
apiKeys.saveWarning: Save your API key securely. We do not store the full key and cannot recover it if lost.
apiKeys.authHeaderInstruction: Pass your key in the Authorization HTTP header:
apiKeys.keyNameHelper: A friendly label describing which service or script uses this key.
apiKeys.scopesHelper: Select only the minimal permissions required for this integration.

webhooks.title: Webhook Endpoints
webhooks.description: Receive signed HMAC-SHA256 HTTP POST notifications when workspace resources change.
webhooks.emptyDesc: Connect external services, Slack bots, or internal event buses by adding a webhook endpoint.
webhooks.pingSuccessToast: Test ping event enqueued for delivery
webhooks.deleteDialogDesc: You will no longer receive notifications at this URL. This cannot be undone.
webhooks.createDesc: Send signed real-time HTTP POST events to your backend or automation services.
webhooks.createdDesc: Save your signing secret to verify payload authenticity.
webhooks.saveSecretWarningDesc: Store this secret securely in your server environment variables. Every request includes an X-UserHQ-Signature header computed using HMAC SHA-256 with this secret.
webhooks.urlHelper: Must be a public HTTPS endpoint reachable by UserHQ.
webhooks.descHelper: Optional note for your team (e.g. 'Slack sync bot')
webhooks.wildcardDesc: Subscribed to all current and future workspace events (wildcard).
webhooks.secretDialogDesc: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
webhooks.secretRotatedWarning: The previous secret stopped working immediately. Update your receiver now; failed deliveries are retried and signed with this secret.
webhooks.emptyLogs: No webhook deliveries recorded yet. Trigger an event or send a test ping to inspect delivery logs.

team.title: Team
team.removeConfirmDesc: They'll lose access to this workspace right away. Anything they created stays.
team.leaveConfirmDesc: You'll lose access to its dashboard. To come back, an admin has to send you a new invite link.
team.emailHelper: Only someone signed in with this email can use the link.
team.inviteCreatedHelp: Copy it now, because it won't be shown again.
team.noInvitesDesc: Create an invite link above to add a teammate.
team.revokeDialogDesc: This invite link will immediately stop working.

settings.productUrlHelper: Changing the URL will change your portal address. Old links will stop working unless updated.
settings.taglineHelper: One line shown on your portal and in link previews.
settings.featuresDesc: Choose what customers can see for this product. Turning a feature off hides it from your portal and keeps all of its content. You can still manage it here and turn it back on at any time.
settings.brandingDesc: Customize your product's accent color and button text styling on the public portal.
settings.accentColorDesc: Themes buttons, highlights, badges, and focus rings.
settings.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting a product takes its portal offline. Its URL cannot be reused.
settings.directoryLabel: Show a public list of products at /{ws}
settings.directoryHelp: Visitors to /{ws} will see a list of your products. If turned off, visitors are redirected to your website.
settings.deleteWorkspaceDesc: Deleting a workspace takes all of its products and portals offline. This cannot be undone.
